verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a public REST API with a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec at api.skyvern.com, per-endpoint reference pages for agents, runs, browser sessions and credentials, API key authentication, a live in-browser playground, and a formal deprecation policy. The probe's 404s on skyvern.com paths do not contradict this, because the spec is served on the api subdomain. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
